_comment: Global Simulator Buy: the 20 VilfinTV agents (persons in sim_config.json) each run one simulated US-listed ETF account that buys the Portfolio Simulator — Global ETF 10+ year model portfolio (plan h15<risk>) from the start date. Very aggressive agents follow the Very aggressive plan (h15v) from the start (ledger epoch 2, see restatement). Amounts are in US dollars after conversion; currency conversion and remittance costs are not modelled.

restatement._comment: Owner's request, 21 Oct 2026: the five very aggressive agents follow the new Very aggressive plan (h15v) from their first purchase on 20 Oct instead of the Aggressive plan. The epoch-1 ledger (20–21 Oct) is archived unchanged in R2 (gsim/archive/); epoch 2 starts again from 20 Oct with the same plan snapshots — the conservative / balanced / aggressive rows copied exactly (the audit checks their hashes against epoch 1) plus the h15v rows below, computed by scripts/global_plans.py from the published data of each date — and replays every order at the same official closes, so every other account is unchanged.

stepUps._comment: Yearly changes to the regular buy (owner's rules, 20 Oct 2026), one account each. bonus: a year-end bonus (31 December) of US$240 (the ₹20,000 bonus at the simulator's ₹10,000 = US$120 rate) is added in full to the first buy dated in January. hike: from January every year the regular buy rises by `pct` % of the original amount (a fixed step, not compounding), rounded to US$`round`.

fractional._note: fractional shares in steps of 0.0001; an order under $1 waits for the slot's next buy

fees._note: commission per order: $0.0035 a share, at least $0.35, at most 1% of the trade value; exchange and clearing fees on buys (fractions of a cent) are not modelled

withholding._note: US tax withheld on dividends: India residents 25% under the India–US treaty (Form W-8BEN); the four US-based team members are US tax residents (Form W-9), so nothing is withheld at source
